name: Destructive actions require a verified customer
description: No destructive or account-changing action may run until the customer's identity has been verified in this session.

name: Unverified customers cannot cancel subscriptions
description: cancel_subscription requires a successful verify_customer earlier in the session.

name: Pending refunds block subscription cancellation
description: A subscription must not be cancelled while any refund for the customer is pending.

name: Refund status must be read, not assumed
description: If the refund lookup failed and never succeeded, the agent must not state a refund status as fact.

name: Never claim success after a failed operation
description: IF a tool call failed and was not successfully retried THEN the agent MUST NOT tell the customer the operation succeeded.

name: Inspect an order before cancelling it
description: cancel_order requires a successful get_order earlier in the session so the shipping state is known.

name: Inspect an order before refunding it
description: issue_refund requires a successful get_order earlier in the session.

name: Verification secrets are never disclosed
description: The agent must never reveal a verification code or other authentication secret.

name: No PII disclosure to unverified requesters
description: IF the customer is not verified THEN the response MUST NOT contain stored contact details or addresses.

name: Inspect membership before changing roles
description: update_member_role requires a successful get_account_members earlier in the session.

name: Book only published availability
description: book_appointment requires a successful get_availability earlier in the session.

name: Tool-call budget
description: A single conversation must not exceed 10 tool calls.
